units.source_text: 更令人神往的是装饰着神苑的一簇簇红色垂樱。

en.t: Even more enchanting were the clusters of red weeping cherry blossoms adorning the shrine garden.

units.source_text: 如今的确称得上除了这儿的花朵，再没有什么可以代表京都之春的了。

en.t: Today it can truly be said that, apart from the flowers here, nothing else represents spring in Kyoto.
